title: IAF Agniveer Vayu 2026: Eligibility, Age & Selection
metaDescription: IAF Agniveer Vayu 2026: age 17.5-22, Class 12 with 50% aggregate and 50% in English, online test, fitness test, adaptability tests and medical.
headline: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu 2026: Eligibility, Selection & Salary

sections.title: What Agniveer Vayu is and who can apply
sections.content:
Agniveer Vayu is the Indian Air Force's entry route under the Agnipath scheme, recruiting young men and women for four years of service in technical, operational and administrative trades across IAF stations. It is distinct from the officer entries: Agniveers serve as airmen-equivalent personnel and may later compete for a limited number of regular-cadre places.

Applicants must be unmarried Indian citizens. The age window is broadly 17.5 to 22 years, with the exact date-of-birth range fixed by each intake notification, so always check the birth dates in the notification for your intake rather than relying on a single age figure.

sections.title: Education: science stream, other streams and diplomas
sections.content:
For the Science Subjects stream, candidates need Class 12 with Mathematics, Physics and English, with at least 50% marks in aggregate and 50% in English. A three-year Engineering Diploma in specified disciplines, or a two-year vocational course with Physics and Mathematics, is also accepted with the same percentage conditions.

For the Other Than Science Subjects stream, Class 12 in any stream with 50% aggregate and 50% in English qualifies, as does a two-year vocational course or a three-year diploma in eligible trades. Boards must be recognised by Central, State or Union Territory authorities, and the percentage conditions apply to every pathway.

sections.title: Selection: online test, fitness, adaptability and medical
sections.content:
Selection begins with an online test covering English, Physics and Mathematics plus a Reasoning and General Awareness component, weighted by the candidate's stream. Shortlisted candidates then face a Physical Fitness Test, followed by Adaptability Test-I and Adaptability Test-II, which assess suitability for service life and are a distinctive feature of the IAF route.

The final stage is a detailed medical examination. The minimum height is 152 cm for both male and female candidates, with relaxations for certain hill-region candidates, and male candidates need a minimum chest of 77 cm with 5 cm expansion. Hearing, dental, vision and general fitness standards apply, and permanent tattoos are restricted to specified areas.

sections.title: Pay, Seva Nidhi and life after four years
sections.content:
The Agnipath package starts at roughly Rs 30,000 a month in the first year and rises each year of the four-year engagement, with a portion contributed to the Seva Nidhi fund. On completion, Agniveers receive the accumulated Seva Nidhi payout plus skill certificates to support civilian employment, and the figures in the current notification govern.

Up to 25% of each batch may be retained in the regular cadre based on performance and organisational need, so the four years are both a service term and an extended selection for a longer career. Those not retained leave with training, experience and a financial cushion that few other school-leaver routes offer.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for Agniveer Vayu 2026?
faqs.a: The broad window is 17.5 to 22 years, with the upper limit applied at enrolment. Each intake notification fixes an exact date-of-birth range, for example 1 January 2005 to 1 July 2009 for one recent intake, so candidates must verify their eligibility against the birth dates in their own notification rather than the headline age alone.

faqs.q: What education is needed for Agniveer Vayu?
faqs.a: Science stream candidates need Class 12 with Mathematics, Physics and English at 50% aggregate and 50% in English, or a three-year Engineering Diploma or two-year vocational course with Physics and Mathematics at the same percentages. Other-stream candidates need Class 12 in any stream at 50% aggregate and 50% in English, or an equivalent vocational or diploma route.

faqs.q: What does the Agniveer Vayu selection process involve?
faqs.a: Selection starts with an online test in English, Physics, Mathematics and Reasoning with General Awareness, weighted by stream. Candidates who clear it attend a Physical Fitness Test, then Adaptability Test-I and Adaptability Test-II assessing psychological suitability for service life, and finally a detailed medical examination before merit-based enrolment.

faqs.q: What are the physical and medical standards?
faqs.a: Minimum height is 152 cm for both male and female candidates, with relaxations for certain North-Eastern and hill-region candidates. Male candidates need a 77 cm chest with 5 cm expansion, weight proportionate to height and age, normal hearing including a forced whisper at 6 metres, at least 14 dental points, and no disqualifying disease or disability.

faqs.q: How long is Agniveer Vayu service and what happens after?
faqs.a: Service is four years under the Agnipath scheme, with a monthly package starting near Rs 30,000 in year one and rising annually, plus Seva Nidhi contributions paid out on exit. Up to 25% of a batch may be retained in the regular cadre on merit and need, while others leave with certificates and experience for civilian careers.
